C2_per_cell_record_vs_cache.rule: for each of the 12 frozen-leg cells and the 3 served questions (15 total): the cache envelope whose URL equals 'https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api/decisions?query=' + expansion_query with spaces replaced by '+' + '&limit=50&offset=0&sort=relevance&fields=full&include_pinpoint=false' must, when its body JSON is parsed, yield results-length and HTTP status EXACTLY equal to the harness-recorded values (leg cells: A1_candidate_only.n_rows and search.status; served cells: A1_candidate.n_rows and envelope status 200 required), AND round(envelope.latency_seconds, 3) must equal the latency_budget.per_search_calls entry matched by query .latency_seconds (the harness's own 3-decimal disclosure of the original live time). Each expansion_query must map to exactly one envelope and every envelope must be claimed by exactly one cell (set relation both directions). Any mismatch cell is a divergence.
